question: Expected: NULL/FAIL — Indian seasonality literature finds no robust 'Sell in May'/month-of-year effect, so 4%-breakout-day outcomes should NOT differ meaningfully by calendar month (Jan-Apr vs May-Sep vs Oct-Dec).
plain: Testing whether the month of the year (e.g. 'Sell in May') changes outcomes after a 4% up day — Indian research says this seasonal effect doesn't hold, so we expect no real difference.
